WP7: T&C table: "Merchant EMI Spends (Any Brand) 1% back as NeuCoins"; the partner rate is "Non-EMI". Same brand list as the partner rules (plus Tata Neu); priority 10 is ahead of every partner rule (11) and of the capped category rules (D29b).

WP7: T&C: for partner Tata Brands "if you have completed your transaction using UPI ... then such transaction will not qualify for this benefit"; UPI earns 0.25% "for transactions done using any UPI ID" (more only with the Tata Neu UPI ID). Carve-out at the any-UPI-ID rate. Priority 9 is ahead of the merchant-EMI carve-out (10), the partner rules (11) and the capped category rules (D29b).

WP7: HDFC MITC fair usage policy: the maximum reward points per statement cycle for Tata Neu Plus* ... is 25,000. MITC footnote: "(*) applicable only on the spend categories that does not have an existing Fair Usage Policy" (C8 D28b). So it targets only the rules without a fair-usage limit of their own: the base rule (base_non_tata_non_upi) and merchant EMI at partner brands (tata_partner_emi_wp7). The Annex 1 partner rules, the capped grocery/insurance/utility/telecom rules and UPI (500/month) keep their own limits.

fee_waiver_rules.notes: Spend ₹1,00,000 or more in the year before the credit-card renewal date.

benefits.label: 1 complimentary domestic lounge voucher per qualifying calendar quarter, up to 4 per calendar year

conditions.emi_treatment: Only the monthly billed EMI principal amount is counted; the original transaction value is not counted.
conditions.reversal_treatment: Reversals are deducted in the quarter in which they post.

perks: Qualified customers are notified by SMS/email.
Voucher must be claimed through the designated claim portal within 120 days of qualification.
Claimed voucher is usable only at the eligible lounge list within 180 days of issuance.
For upgraded, lost or reissued cards, only spends on the new card count toward qualification.
Direct complimentary swipe/tap access was discontinued in favour of the milestone voucher mechanism.

benefits.label: Zero-cost card liability for reported fraudulent transactions

perks: Fraudulent transactions reported immediately are covered under the bank's zero-cost card-liability feature.
